queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: GitHub search syntax, e.g. topic:mcp stars:>50, created:>2026-10-01 language:Rust, pushed:>2026-09-01 stars:>100. Same qualifiers as github.com/search.

maxReposPerQuery.title: Max repos per query
maxReposPerQuery.description: Capped at GitHub Search API limit of 1000 results per query. 0 = 1000.

token.title: GitHub token (optional)
token.description: Personal access token (classic or fine-grained with public_repo read). Raises Search rate limit from 10 to 30 req/min. Leave empty for unauthenticated.
